sections.title: Letter A sound
paragraphs: The letter (A) /æ/ names this sign. You hear its main sound in (apple) /æ.pəl/, which is a round fruit. This letter has four sounds in English words. Each sound depends on the place of the letter and the stress of the syllable. Listen carefully to each word.

sections.title: How to say letter A
paragraphs: Open your mouth wide and keep your tongue low and front. Next, start with your mouth open and glide your tongue up toward your top teeth. For the weak sound, relax your whole mouth and let air pass gently. For the deep sound, drop your jaw low and pull your tongue back. Touch your throat to feel voice every time.

sections.title: Letter A spelling
paragraphs: In closed stressed syllables, this letter makes its short sound, as in (cat) /kæt/. In open syllables or before a silent e, it makes a long sound, as in (bake) /beɪk/. In unstressed syllables, it becomes a weak schwa, as in (ago) /ə.ɡoʊ/. Before certain consonant letters like lm, it makes a deep sound, as in (calm) /kɑːm/.

sections.title: Letter A mistakes
paragraphs: Do not replace the short sound with the vowel in car. Keep your tongue low and front, and open your mouth wide. Do not say the long sound as a flat vowel. Let your tongue glide smoothly upward from the start to the end. Relax your mouth completely when the syllable has no stress.
